current_task_corrections.correction: Enable cite_artifacts in brief_sections parameters to attach source citations to every numeric statement in the executive brief.
Set brief_sections.cite_artifacts to true to achieve complete citation coverage across all numeric statements, ensuring reproducibility requirements are met.
Set brief_sections.causal_language to 'avoid' to eliminate causal phrasing and restrict language to strictly associative descriptions of relationships.

reusable_lessons.lesson: Executive briefs require full citation coverage for reproducibility and credibility. Always enable cite_artifacts in brief_sections to ensure numeric statements carry source references.

Executive communications to leadership should use only associative language when describing relationships. Set causal_language to 'avoid' to eliminate phrases that may overstate causality and reduce precision in stakeholder reporting.
